{Note: The outlaw Thom Wilmot is pretending to be a courier named Hieronymus to con his way onto the estate of a rich woman, Lady Fairfax & her young daughter, Guinevere. He offers her a locket stolen at gunpoint from a cavalier.}

Having previously introduced myself, I invited Lady Guinevere for a walk with me upon the estate. We walked together sharing confidences, arm in arm, through the gardens to the side of the lake. There I shewed Guinevere the fine silver locket within my breast pocket.

Her eyes grew wide & sparkled, “May I hold it a moment?” she asked.

“Surely.” I pressed the trinket within her outstretched palm. She stood mesmerized, fingering the floral engraving upon its cover. Finally she pulled it open twixt her fingers. The locket chimed an amiable tune, which landed sweet upon her delicate ears. “Oh my! It’s absolutely charming!” she enthused. “But what are these initials: B-K?”

Drat. Twas the initials of the thieved cavalier’s sweetheart, no doubt. “Um,” I searched for mine words through twisted tongue, “Tis the initials of my first love… the British Kingdom. For you know dearest Guinevere that I am a soldier of fervent patriotism.” That should do it I think. “Tell me, do you like it?

“That's an understatement, my lord. It's positively exquisite. You must value it immensely."

“Aye, tis kept in the breast pocket over my heart,” I snapped my fingers together, “You know, I just had a splendid idea. The sun has grown so hot & we perspire profusely. If you will have a cool swim with me in the lake I shall gift you the locket.”

She was resistant though, “But mother would be furious with me if I returned home in wet clothes, sir.”

“Aye? So we shall take them off.” I demonstrated by unbuttoning mine shirt. I could tell by her looks that Guinevere was much pleased with my physique.

“H-hieronymus, oh… oh my. Is it proper?” stammered my young maiden.

“Of course,” I persuaded. “I am your father’s man after all; sworn to protect the honor of my captain & his progeny alike.”

“I suppose tis true… & I desire the locket ever so much.”

“Very well then,” I undressed till I was naked for all of nature to behold. Guinevere shyly followed my lead, pulling the dress from around her shoulders & then slipping out of her undergarments till they piled loosely upon the ground. What a pleasure she was to behold! Pale & sensuous was her physique, from breast to buttocks. I felt a powerful stirring within my loins. I could not help but to mast right then & there.

Guinevere’s mouth fell agape at the sight of my erect manhood. “What is that thing, Hieronymus?”

“Why… this? I’m surprised you do not know. I’d heard tell that your mother had informed you in all matters of sophisticated knowledge.”

“No, not this one sir. I suddenly feel so faint; so flush. Excuse my embarrassment gentle Hieronymus.” “Tis a trifle my dear. But I fear that by withholding this knowledge from you, your parents have truly disadvantaged you for the intrigues of high society & the wooing of a proper suitor.”

Guinevere was much distressed, “Oh? You've located the greatest sorrow of my heart Hieronymus. I am so very much neglected of parentage, with mine father always away at war & mother with her great dedication to tutelage.”

I feigned indignation at this slight of my lady, “How cruel of them not to impart tenderness & knowledge to a lass of such prodigious curiosity!” I began to close the gap betwixt us, “I must confess that you are quite pleasing to look upon with mine eyes & methinks your tender charms could carry you far within society… if only your education was more thorough.”

Guinevere’s lovely lips parted into a smile, “You do me an undeserved kindness, my lord for I am destined to be a dilettante of no sophistication.”

I played the part of one in deep thought, “Yes, tis pity…”, until I came to an idea, “A-ha! Lovely Guinevere, would you do the honor of allowing me to impart some tutelage upon your person?” I moved in e’en closer, within but a touch of her trembling body.

“I-I,” Guinevere stammered. But before she could continue, I planted my lips roughly against her own, drawing her by the small of her back towards my chest. I could practically inhale the excitement of her body; her flowering aroma. As her knees quaked I gently laid her down upon the grasses. And then I meticulously escorted young Lady Guinevere into womanhood.

Once my wanton craving had been satisfied, however temporarily, my mind returned its present occupation: the looting of Captain Fairfax’s estate. Laying there in the grass with Guinevere upon my chest, I determined to execute my caper the following evening.
